entry.subtitle: Meta page for regional surname wordcloud posts
entry.excerpt: A navigation hub for regional surname wordcloud visualizations, with methodology notes and a legacy-style grid.
entry.content:

The bigger the "word" size, the more common the respective surname is . Databases of global surnames aggregated by admin units were used to access raw data on surname frequencies. Then, surnames were allocated within their respective admin units to create easier-to-read visuals in the form of "word clouds" (aka "tag clouds"). Some description about "raster vs vector" formats, georeferencing in general and current geo-referencing for vector images.
Raster files are images built from pixels - tiny color squares that form detailed images. More pixels = higher quality.
Vector files use mathematical equations (lines and curves), so they scale without losing quality.
See:{" "} adobe com/creativecloud/file-types/image/comparison/raster-vs-vector
Georeferencing (or georegistration) is the process of aligning spatial data (raster or vector) to real-world coordinates.
See:{" "} Georeferencing wiki
